text:
Jenna: hey all  quick question on channel hygiene: where should I post a small infra config snippet vs a long debug log vs a customer-facing blip?
Omar: welcome Jenna! short snippets (2-8 lines) can go inline with triple backticks in the team channel. long logs -> gist or internal drive + link. customer-facing incidents -> #support or #customer-success, depending on context.
Jenna: makes sense. what's the preferred way to ack something instead of writing a long 'thanks'?
Omar: use emoji reacts (:thumbsup:, :eyes:) for simple acks. For cross-team asks, reply in-thread with one line and tag the owner so there's a visible trail.
Jenna: got it. how do I stop devtools notif spam for PR builds that fail constantly?
DevToolsBot: Use `@DevToolsBot subscribe --type=prs --filter=author:<you>` to only get PRs you touch, or set `@DevToolsBot snooze 1h` in a channel. Do not mute #eng-oncall or #incidents.
Jenna: perfect. are there pinned templates for intro and daily updates?
Omar: yes  pinned in #new-hires and also in each team channel. Intro template: "Name | Pronouns | Team | TZ | 1-line focus | fun fact". Daily update template: "Done / In-progress / Blocked (who)".
onboarding-buddy: I'll DM you the checklist and add the pinned links to your calendar invite. Also we'll do a quick channel-ops walkthrough at 2pm.
people-ops: FYI badge and chair requests go in #people-ops. Use the "Equipment" form link in the channel details.
Jenna: awesome, this helps a ton. thanks everyone :tada:
